s.g: Suffix forming diminutives from nouns. Ultimately an extended form of -ulus.

ety.text: From the diminutive suffix -culus (itself from -ulus), by rebracketing of diminutives derived from original s-stem nouns and adjectives, such as opusculum (“little work”) from opus, operis n (“work”) and meliusculus (“a little better”) from melior, melius, meliōr- (“better”).
